scorecard.venue: Bharat Ratna Shri Atal Bihari Vajpayee Ekana Cricket Stadium, Lucknow

batting.name: MR Marsh
batting.dismissal: c M Jansen b Arshdeep Singh

batting.name: N Pooran
batting.dismissal: c GJ Maxwell b YS Chahal

batting.name: RR Pant
batting.dismissal: c YS Chahal b GJ Maxwell

batting.name: A Badoni
batting.dismissal: c GJ Maxwell b Arshdeep Singh

batting.name: DA Miller
batting.dismissal: c P Simran Singh b M Jansen

batting.name: Abdul Samad
batting.dismissal: c Priyansh Arya b Arshdeep Singh

batting.name: Priyansh Arya
batting.dismissal: c SN Thakur b DS Rathi

batting.name: P Simran Singh
batting.dismissal: c Ravi Bishnoi b DS Rathi

balls.text: just short, and Thakur smuggles a second as LSG finish on 171! Full and wide. Thakur gets under it and chips it towards deep point. Ferguson cannot get to it and then misfields slightly to allow Thakur to scamper back for the second
zipped into the blockhole on middle and off. Thakur jams it out towards mid on. Dot ball!

back of a length wide outside off. Avesh swings like a rusty gate and to no one's surprise, misses. Thakur, though, is alert enough to sneak in another run. But hang on, the Kings have reviewed this. Could be touch-and-go. Seems to be just beyond the revised guidelines (due to Avesh's back foot being just outside off) and the wide call stays!

soft, soft dismissal and LSG are losing their way in the final over! Hung up full and wide outside off. Samad has no option but to swish at it but only manages a tame outside edge due to the angle. Simple catch for Arya at short third, and that will be that for Samad with the bat tonight!
back of a length outside off. Thakur waits for it and dabs it towards deep point to get Samad back on strike

miscued and taken by Maxwell! Badoni's rear-guard effort comes to an end! Off-pace on a back of a length outside off. Badoni shapes up to hack it over cow corner but the lack of pace, plus the fact that he is fighting the angle, means that he chalks it off the toe-end. Maxwell runs around to his left from deep mid wicket and does the rest! A good innings, but he cannot quite see LSG through to 175-180!
Arshdeep tests out the middle of the track outside off and it responds much more than he expects. Balloons over the batter's head and some more exercise for the umpire
low full toss wide outside off. Samad shuffles across, fetches it and sweeps it towards deep mid wicket. Excellent bowling, given the field he has
slower ball on a full length outside off. Samad has an ungainly swipe at it and tugs it towards long on
hard length just outside off. Rushes onto Badoni much quicker than he expects and he cloths it towards long off
full and wide outside off. Badoni nearly swings himself off his feet and chips it over extra cover for a couple of runs
into the blockhole on middle and off. Samad digs it out and gets it enough to the bowler's left to pick up a single
slot ball outside off. Badoni sits deep in his crease and drags it towards deep mid wicket
dug in much shorter and this flies through. Well over Badoni's swing and well over his head too and the keeper does well to rein it in
dug into the track on middle and leg. Gets big on Samad as he looks to pull and he splices it towards deep mid wicket
into the blockhole on off. Samad has to abandon his attempted lap mid-way and chalks it towards extra cover

Samad is toying with the field and the bowling now! Arshdeep more or less nails the wide yorker but still gets hit to the fence. Talk about placement. Samad opened up his bat face late and guided it between deep point and deep third!

oh wow, don't know how to describe that shot! Low full toss hung up wide outside off. Samad reaches out for it while being in position for the scoop and somehow gets it over the keeper's head. Between the keeper and short fine leg to be precise, and that was some shot!
kaboom! Samad with his second maximum of the evening! Marginally short outside off. Samad goes back and across, stands up on his toes and whacks it out of sight over long on!
slower ball on a length outside off. Badoni gets on top of the bounce and drives it towards sweeper cover
splits the gap! Short outside off and Badoni pounces. Gets his hands through the ball swiftly and threads it between backward point and short third!
thrown up full and wide, possibly pre-empting the charge. Badoni reaches out for it and powers it to sweeper cover, stationed fairly straight
length on middle and leg. Samad stands up tall and knocks it to long on
back of a length on middle and leg. Badoni stabs it enough to the bowler's right and hares across to the other end
Badoni goes bang! Floated up, on a length just outside leg. Badoni dances down the track, gives himself swinging room and smokes it over the bowler's head!
fired in full on the pads. Samad works it towards deep mid wicket
pushed in full and following the batter outside leg. Badoni cannot get under it, nor can he create enough room for himself. Clinks it towards long on

just over! A golden duck transforms into a first-ball six by the smallest of margins! Full and angled across outside off. Samad gives Jansen the charge and then throws the kitchen sink at it. Slices it towards sweeper cover, where Arshdeep is very interested. Just at the end, though, the ball evades him, sailing over his head!

nicked and gone! Jansen breaks through and everyone associated with LSG is stunned! Back of a length in the fifth stump channel. Miller goes flaying at it away from his body and with minimal footwork. Does not cover the line and the ball straightens just enough to take the outside edge. Flies through to Prabhsimran, who does the rest, and LSG lose their fourth and final overseas batter!
back of a length outside off. Miller presses half forward and punches it towards mid off
in the slot just outside off. Badoni tries to hit it too hard and loses shape. Shanks it down to long on in the end
off-pace on a back of a length on leg stump. Badoni looks to work to leg but plays all around it, getting pinged on the thigh pad
on a length on middle and off. Miller presses forward and drives it on the up to long on
short outside off. Miller waits in his crease and jabs it towards sweeper cover
back of a length just outside off. Skids onto Miller and he shanks it back towards the bowler
goes fuller outside off. Miller gets onto the front foot and pushes it to extra cover
another boundary, with exactly the same shot! On the shorter side, on middle and off. Miller opens up his stance and punishes it between deep mid wicket and deep square leg!
darted in full on the stumps. Miller presses forward and pokes it back to the bowler
and Maxwell gets smashed to the fence! Dragged down on leg stump. Miller rocks back early and pummels it between deep mid wicket and deep backward square leg!
full just outside off. Badoni stretches forward and stabs it towards the bowler
fullish on middle and off. Miller lets the ball come to him before knocking it to long on
First boundary for David Miller tonight! Given air again but this is into the slot outside off. Miller opens his bat face upon contact and knifes it to extra cover's right!
flighted up full on middle and off. Miller comes forward and pokes it towards extra cover

googly on a length on leg stump. Miller works it into the spaces between long on and deep mid wicket . There is a massive mix-up between the batters but the throw is not great and Miller can sprawl to make his ground at the batter's end
back of a length on middle and off. Skids onto Miller and he has to hurriedly play it back to the bowler off the back foot
oh wow - that is a shot and a half! Slower ball on a length outside off. Badoni picks the variation early, stands up tall and caresses it over extra cover!
sharp short ball just outside off. Gets a little big on Miller but he does well to ride the bounce and fend it past wide slip for a single
very full outside off. Badoni jams down on it and squeezes it out to sweeper cover
angled in full on leg stump. Miller falls across and then plays all around it. Pings off his boot towards deep third. Might have been sliding down leg
shortish outside off, bowled from around the wicket. Miller gets up on his toes and jabs it towards backward point
zipped in full on the pads. Badoni uses his wrists and whisks it towards deep backward square leg
slowed up even more, full on middle and off. Badoni gives himself a bit of room and pushes it towards sweeper cover
tossed up again, full on middle and leg. Badoni pokes it back to the bowler
floated up full and wide. Miller reaches out for it and drives it towards long off

Chahal outwits Pooran, and he roars in delight! What a moment in the game! Dangles the carrot outside off and Pooran bites. He looks to go straight but the googly and the angle is always taking it away from the batter. He cuts across it too much and spoons it towards long off. Maxwell settles under it and snares the chance. Pooran storms off livid, and this is a big, big wicket, fashioned by Punjab's premier spinner!
googly on a back of a length wide outside off. Pooran shapes for the cut but only swishes at thin air this time
very full on leg stump. Badoni digs it out towards long off
four more! PBKS, all of a sudden, are leaking boundaries! Slow, short, wide and asking to be hit. Pooran obliges and thrashes it just behind point!
Pooran is well and truly on the charge now! Banged in short outside off and Pooran has telegraphed this. He waits for it, brings those fast hands into play and scythes it over backward point!
full just outside off. Badoni drives it to long on with a straight bat
pushed in a full length on middle stump. Pooran comes forward and turns it towards deep mid wicket

shorter and even wider outside off. Pooran jabs it towards backward point and sets off for the single. Badoni, though, sends him back and does so just in the nick of time. Pooran regains his ground, despite a direct hit. Shedge was the fielder
short and wide outside off. Pooran jumps up into the air and slashes at it, only to connect with fresh air
tossed up very full on middle and off. Badoni digs it out towards the bowler, who fields it on his follow-through
shortish outside off. Pooran probably tries to hit it too hard and chops it towards backward point
Pooran is tearing Chahal apart! This is slower, floatier and also in the slot on off stump. Pooran plants his front foot, goes through the line and slams it over the bowler's head!
that has been scorched across the turf! Googly on a length outside off. Pooran uses his reach, gets on top of the bounce and razes it through point!
googly on a back of a length outside off. Pooran does not pick it and goes feeling for it, with the ball fizzing past the outside edge
short and wide outside off. Pooran sits deep in his crease and cuts it towards extra cover, who misfields. The ball has enough on it and eventually hits the fence!
low full toss just outside off. Badoni flicks it towards mid wicket and sets off for the single initially, only to be sent back by his partner
back of a length outside off and this zips off the surface, beating Badoni for pace as he looks to cut
full on middle and leg. Pooran comes forward and eases it to long on
length outside off. Badoni stays on top of the bounce and drives on the up towards sweeper cover
back of a length on off. Badoni presses half forward and taps it tamely towards mid wicket
slow and short outside off. Pooran sits deep in his crease and cuts it towards deep point
full outside off. Badoni laces his cover drive but cannot get it past the fielder at extra cover. He will feel he missed out there
off-pace, angling in full on the pads. Pooran eases it out to deep square leg. That was bowled at 127.8kph
short ball outside leg, bowled at 135.1kph. Badoni gets inside the line and helps it down to fine leg
slower ball on a full length outside off. Badoni comes forward and pushes it towards extra cover

Badoni wants a piece of the action now! Banged into the track on middle and off. Badoni spots the length early and even though he takes his eyes off it slightly, he hooks it well over the fine leg fence!
back of a length outside off. Pooran opens up his stance and hacks it towards long on
floated up fuller outside off. Pooran stretches forward and drives it to long off

Pooran makes it two fours in two balls! Dragged down on middle and leg. Skids onto Pooran and he cloths it a little. Still finds the gap between long on and deep mid wicket, though. And gets an earful from Maxwell too, who, fair to say, did not enjoy that shot
Pooran breaks the shackles! Slanted in on a length down leg. Pooran picks the line early and uses the pace to paddle it fine. No fielder there, and Pooran picks up his first boundary!
slower on a back of a length just outside off. Pooran hangs back and prods it towards backward point
fired in full on leg stump. Pooran presses forward and turns it towards mid wicket
back of a length on middle and leg. Badoni hangs back and works it towards deep backward square leg
back of a length wide outside off. Pooran goes fishing at it and only grabs a handful of fresh air
back of a length just outside off. Pooran stays back and defends
back of a length outside off. Pooran taps it towards cover point, who over-runs it and ends up conceding two, when there should have been none. Arya the guilty party in the ring
snorter! Back of a length in the fifth stump channel. Rears up off the surface and nips away too. Pooran, feeling for it, is beaten all ends up
shortish again, just outside off. Badoni uses the angle, hops up onto his toes and runs it down to short third, whose misfield allows the single
dug into the track just outside off. Badoni gets up on his toes and pats it back towards the bowler
pushed in full on the pads. Badoni tucks it off his pads towards deep square leg and gets off the mark

straight to short fine leg, and Pant will be kicking himself! Not the greatest ball Maxwell will ever bowl in his life, but that has got the job done tonight. A half-tracker outside leg and Pant ought to have hit that into next week. Instead, he picks out Chahal at short fine leg and he cannot believe what he has done. Thousands of LSG fans in the stands, and many more at home cannot believe it either, and LSG lose their third!
back of a length on middle and off. Pant presses forward initially before hopping back and turning it towards mid wicket
back of a length on off. Pooran goes back and knocks it to long off
fired in fuller on leg stump. Pant nudges it into the mid wicket region and gets Pooran on strike
angled in full on middle and off. Pant has a tentative poke at it and chunks it off the inside edge into his front pad
shortish on leg stump. Pant gets up on his toes and tucks it off his hips towards deep backward square leg

Markram bites the dust now, and Ferguson has the last laugh! Twists, turns everywhere! On a length outside off and this seems to just nip back in a shade. Markram looks to drive on the up and leaves a gap between bat and pad. The ball sneaks through, perhaps helped by an inside edge and off stump gets pegged back. A sprightly cameo but someone else will have to take up the mantle for LSG now!
that is the shot of the evening so far! My word - Markram is on fire! Dug into the track outside off and offering plenty of width. Markram peels the outer cover off the ball and carves it over point!

Markram is turning on the style tonight! Another yorker gone wrong, although Ferguson misses on the shorter side this time, on middle and off. Markram plants his front foot and pumps it over Ferguson's head!
very full outside off. Pooran opens his bat face and glides it towards deep backward point
well well! Borderline waist-high full toss outside off. Markram is taken aback by it and dabs it towards short third. Might have been a slower ball that went awry
shorter and wider outside off. Markram throws his hands at it and cuts it powerfully to deep backward point. Just a single this time
shot! Hard length just outside off and that is all the room Markram needs. He stays leg side, stands up tall and cracks it past cover point. Majestic!
that is Markram at his absolute best! Arshdeep goes searching and bowls it into the slot on middle and leg. Markram goes through the line and bangs it over the bowler's head!
dropped - oh dear! Fullish on leg stump. Markram plants his front foot and drives it straight back at Arshdeep. He gets both hands to it to his right but cannot make it stick. That came at him fast
back of a length on middle and leg and this shapes back in sharply. Markram is nearly cut in half and inside-edges it onto his body
in the air and just past the fielder! Full on the pads and that is there to be hit. Markram flicks it uppishly and just manages to beat mid wicket to his left!
into the blockhole just outside off. Pooran jams down on it and scuffs it off the inside edge into his pads
back of a length, finishing on middle and off. Pooran gets up on his toes and meets the ball right under his eyes
low full toss just outside off. Takes Markram by surprise and he can only clink it towards mid off. Scampers across to complete the single
hard length just outside off. Markram looks to drive through cover on the up but chunks it off the inside half of the bat towards mid wicket
angled in on a back of a length just outside off. Markram gets behind the line and presents the full face of the bat
speared way down leg and Prabhsimran actually does well to get a glove to this, with the ball curving further away. Called a wide and LSG get two bonus runs
back of a length wide outside off. Markram opens his bat face and guides it towards deep backward point
shortish and offering width. Markram throws his hands at it and slices it towards deep backward point. Good work on the fence to keep it to a single
full outside off, shaping away nicely. Pooran gets onto the front foot and drives it towards sweeper cover

wicked delivery, and Arshdeep gets the better of Marsh in the first over! Back of a length ball that starts outside leg and then does all sorts, sizzling and swerving away from Marsh. He gets into an awful tangle and the extra bounce causes him even more grief. Goes straight up off the leading edge and Jansen calls early to gobble it up in the short third region. Punjab Kings on the board early and Marsh, after two successive fifties, goes for a golden duck!
back of a length on middle and off. Swings away late and Markram drops it into the off side with soft hands. Off the mark with a single
shortish on middle and leg. A hint of shape back in and Markram gets up on his toes to punch it to mid on
back of a length angled across the batter outside off. Markram watches it go through to the keeper

Start the car, we are outta here! A clinical, clinical display and the Punjab Kings flex their muscles for the second time in as many games, and LSG have been battered, bruised and beaten quite comprehensively! This is slower and also into the slot on leg stump. Shreyas uses those long levers and wallops it over wide long on. A fitting way to end another commanding performance and Shreyas, their star from the first game, finishes the job with utmost conviction!
back of a length, following Shreyas outside leg. He gets tucked up and chops it towards extra cover
back of a length outside off. Wadhera waits for it and dabs it towards backward point. Dot ball and that means we will have a time-out now
scores level now! Wadhera is putting LSG to the sword! Fullish on middle and leg. Wadhera skips down the track and blasts it back past the bowler!
one more six, and the engine of the car is surely revving now! Another loose shortish delivery that sits up on leg stump. Wadhera picks it up and butchers it over deep backward square leg!
this is such pure hitting! Marginally short on middle and leg, and Wadhera climbs into it. He stays still and then clobbers the living daylights out of this one. High and long over deep mid wicket!
back of a length outside off. Wadhera waits for it and dabs it towards backward point
hard length on middle and off. Wadhera gets behind the line and stabs it back to the bowler
pick the bones out of that one! Avesh goes short again and at this point, he might as well have faxed it to Shreyas. The PBKS captain is waiting for it and he clatters it over deep mid wicket!
cutter bowled into the track outside off. Shreyas looks for the pick-up pull to this back of a length ball but only swats away a few flies
Shreyas is in a hurry to get back to his hotel as well! Right in the slot on middle and off. Shreyas shows the maker's name and pops it over mid off!
dug into the track on off. Wadhera gets up on his toes and hacks it towards deep square leg
off-pace and into the track outside off. Shreyas is too early into the pull and cloths it towards deep mid wicket
back of a length outside off. Shreyas hangs back and jabs it towards backward point

brilliant catch, but that is by the ball-boy and of course it will not count! Tossed up into the slot just outside off. Wadhera gets his front foot out of the way and clubs it flat over the wide long on fence!
hung up wide on a length. Wadhera reaches out for it and scuffs it towards extra cover
zipped in full on leg stump. Wadhera has a swipe at it and squirts it off the inside edge towards short fine leg
follows up the six with a four! Shortish and offering plenty of width. Wadhera throws the lot at it and crashes it past extra cover!
right out of the screws this time! Given a bit of air, just outside off and that is all Wadhera needs. He slaloms down the track and launches it clean over long on!
back of a length outside off. Wadhera tries to hit it too hard and scuffs it towards extra cover
fullish just outside off. Wadhera drops it into the off side and calls his skipper through for the single

back of a length outside off. Shreyas dabs it towards backward point and looks at his partner, who responds and goes for the single. Wadhera has to stretch but makes it in the end, despite a direct hit
tossed up full on middle and off. Shreyas gets onto the front foot and defends

genuine edge, and Shreyas, for all of Rathi's toil, will get four! Ripping delivery on a length outside off. Nips away and Shreyas, feeling for it, gets a thick outside edge that races away past short third!
shortish on leg stump. Wadhera swivels and pulls it towards deep backward square leg
oh dear! Fizzed through on a back of a length just outside off. Wadhera gets into a mess trying to play the reverse and ends up on the deck eventually, with Pant nearly falling on top of him
shortish outside off. Wadhera throws his hands at it and cuts it towards deep backward point
back of a length on leg stump. Shreyas tucks it off his pads towards deep square leg
back of a length outside off. Wadhera hangs back and knocks it to long on
back of a length wide outside off. Wadhera tries to fetch it and swipe it through square leg but only connects with the fresh Lucknow air
back of a length outside off. Defended off the back foot
short on off. Shreyas gives himself plenty of room and jabs it towards sweeper cover

what timing! Exquisite! Back of a length outside off. Sits up a little and Wadhera, hanging back in his crease, creams it past extra cover. That sped across to the fence and gave the sweeper no chance!
back of a length, pitching outside leg and finishing on off. Wadhera taps it towards mid wicket. Wanted the single but was sent back
fired in full on middle and off. Wadhera looks for the reverse and scuffs it towards first slip
away-going delivery, hung up on a length wide outside off. Wadhera nearly swishes himself off his feet and still cannot make contact
length outside off. Wadhera comes forward and jabs it enough to sweeper cover's left for a couple of runs. Shreyas had to hustle but made it back comfortably enough

exceptional work on the fence, and Prabhsimran's fun is over for the night! Darted in on a length just outside off. Prabhsimran has a massive mow across the line and skews it towards deep mid wicket. Badoni takes it initially on the deep mid wicket fence, only to realize he might step onto the rope. He then pops it back into the air, and Bishnoi, who has followed up from deep square leg, is in position to dive and complete the catch. Excellent synchronization, and excellent execution. But has Prabhsimran already put the game beyond LSG?!
slower ball that ends up as a low full toss wide outside off. Prabhsimran drills it towards sweeper cover and retains strike
banged into the track on off. Shreyas opens up his stance and hacks it towards fine leg
peach! Back of a length outside off and this zips off the surface. Moves away a little too and whistles past the outside edge
high and deep into the stands! Thakur tests Shreyas out with a short ball on off but Shreyas is ready for it. More or less. Gets into a tangle initially but then recovers to hook it over fine leg!

back of a length on off. Prabhsimran gets right behind the line and nurdles it towards mid wicket. Calls for the single and might have struggled had Siddharth gathered cleanly. He missed the ball on the first go, though, making the single a very comfortable exercise
slower ball hung up wide outside off. Left alone and the umpire has no qualms in calling it a wide
length on middle and leg. Shreyas presses half forward and punches it to long on
back of a length on leg stump. Shreyas goes back and eases it to deep mid wicket
fired in way outside the right-hander's leg stump, after seeing Prabhsimran switch. In the end, he plays a square cut as a left-hander and picks up a single
shortish on middle and off. Shreyas gives himself room and chops it towards short third, who puts in the dive to his right and ensures it is just a single. Rathi the fielder
very full on leg stump. Prabhsimran digs it out towards long on
watch out, umpire! Given a bit of air on middle and off. Prabhsimran comes out of his bunker and bludgeons it back past the bowler. Good reflexes from the umpire too!
length on middle and leg. Shreyas has a poke at it and squirts it off the inside edge towards short fine leg
Prabhsimran is pounding LSG into submission! Another half-tracker, this time well outside leg. Prabhsimran swivels inside the line and dumps it over short fine leg!

that is cheeky with a capital C! Loose full toss outside off. Prabhsimran shapes for the scoop very early and does not change his stroke, despite the full toss. Watches it till the last moment and laps it over the keeper's head. Almost a reverse-ramp!
back of a length on middle and off. Cramped for room. Prabhsimran plays it back to the bowler off the back foot
back of a length on the stumps. Shreyas goes back and pushes it towards deep mid wicket
shortens the length after seeing the batter advance. Prabhsimran tries to tonk it into tomorrow and squirts it off the inside edge towards short fine leg
speared in full on off. Prabhsimran gets down on one knee and hacks it towards deep mid wicket for a couple of runs
back of a length on leg stump. Prabhsimran tucks it off his pads towards deep mid wicket and brings up a 23-ball half-century! His first this season, and the first of many PBKS will hope!
full on leg stump. Shreyas gets a good stride in and turns it towards deep mid wicket
angled down leg. Prabhsimran misses it and Pant cannot gather either. Two more runs added to the Kings' total
much quicker and fuller on leg stump. Shreyas eases it out to deep mid wicket
Shreyas showing off his repertoire too now! Floated up full on middle and off. Shreyas makes room for himself and caresses it beautifully over extra cover!
angled in on a length on leg stump. Prabhsimran drops it into the on side and canters across to the other end. Might have been off the pad actually
shot! Fired in on a length just outside leg. Prabhsimran brings out the switch hit and smacks it over backward point for four!
follows the batter outside leg with a full ball. Prabhsimran bunts it to mid wicket and scuttles across to the other end
darted in full outside off. Prabhsimran gets onto the front foot and blocks

my goodness - Prabhsimran is producing some drool-worthy strokes! Flighted up on a length outside off. Prabhsimran does not get to the pitch of the ball but it does not matter to him. Clean swing through the line and he crrrrrrrrunnnnnnnchhhhesssss it over extra cover!
another sweep executed to absolute perfection! Slower and shorter on off. Prabhsimran gets down early, gets under it and lifts it over backward square leg!
over the top again! Prabhsimran shimmies around before the ball is bowled and then settles just outside leg. Picks up this slot ball on the stumps and thumps it over mid on!
fired in full just outside off. Prabhsimran lunges forward and pokes it back to the bowler
Shreyas lands his first punch now! Googly hung up on a length wide outside off. Shreyas reaches out for it and blasts it between mid off and extra cover!
back of a length on off. Shreyas stays leg side and dabs it towards short third
fired in on a length on off. Prabhsimran goes right back and nudges it into the straight mid wicket region
fullish on off. Prabhsimran gets onto the front foot and defends calmly
over the infield again! Strays onto the pads and the length allows Prabhsimran to get down on the sweep and help it over backward square leg!
length outside off. Shreyas lets the ball come to him before chopping it into the off side
back of a length outside off. Shreyas gets up on his toes and guides it towards deep backward point
another short ball outside off. Shreyas has a swipe across the line but only swats away a few flies. Might have been a little early on that pull
back of a length just outside off. Prabhsimran drops it into the off side and calls his partner through for an easy single
oh my days - that is an amazing shot! Dug into the track outside off. Prabhsimran walks down the track and then plays a tennis forehand that Novak Djokovic would be proud of. Flat over wide long off!
short and wide outside off. Prabhsimran stands up tall and slaps it on the bounce to mid off
back of a length just outside off. Shreyas gets up on his toes and jabs it towards deep backward point
banged into the track but also sliding down leg. Shreyas can get inside the line and the umpire calls it a wide
back of a length on middle and leg, angling into Shreyas. He goes back and works it towards deep mid wicket

goes straight up, and taken! Rathi breaks through, and he runs up to Arya to give him a bit of a send-off - something about writing down his name in his wicket-taking book! Dug in shorter and this spins away to finish outside off. Arya tries to drag it leg-side but cannot fight the angle. Skews it straight up and Thakur, running in from mid on, does the rest. Rathi is pumped and delighted, as his celebration shows, and the Kings have been dented!
fullish on off. Arya gets onto the front foot and defends solidly
hard length just outside off and this cuts back in, cramping the batter considerably. Prabhsimran tugs it behind square
dropped at slip! Angled in on a length wide outside off. Arya has a massive swish at it and gets a thick outside edge. Flies through to Marsh, who cannot hold on. Burst through the hands there
half-tracker outside off and it gets the treatment it deserves! Arya hops back and muscles it to deep mid wicket's right!
fullish on off. Arya shuffles across again and tucks it off his pads towards deep square leg
